item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00136","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C09","C02","C11"],"selected_candidate_label":"C09","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C09 is a highly plausible drafting template. It uses the same three-recital structure, the same National Mediation Board finding concerning interruption of interstate commerce within named states, and the same operative machinery: a report within thirty days followed by the section 10 prohibition on changing the conditions underlying the dispute. The child principally substitutes the carrier, unions, and affected state. C02 and C11 are also very close instances of the same reusable form, but C09 is the strongest because it immediately precedes the child and most closely matches the state-specific
